tasks.title: Linear BEC heating
tasks.solution: P = (U_in − U_out)·I. That's why a linear BEC from 6S (22.2 V nominal) to 5 V at 1 A means ~17 W of heat (~20 W from a full 25.2 V pack); you need a switching one.
